log: A Tavern welcomes you before The Lucent Depths.

enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you. Prepare matching Guard for the telegraphed 30-damage Final Blast; it can be defended normally.

enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you. Prepare matching Guard for the telegraphed 30-damage Final Blast; it can be defended normally.

enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.

enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you. Prepare matching Guard for the telegraphed 30-damage Final Blast; it can be defended normally.

enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element. The next turn fires only Final Blast: 30 damage of that element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you. Prepare matching Guard for the telegraphed 30-damage Final Blast; it can be defended normally.
